name: arXiv API
description: Search and metadata for 2.5 million preprints in physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, statistics and economics, as Atom XML. Full text is available as PDF and, in bulk, from a requester-pays S3 bucket. The place to see a field's output weeks or years before journals catch up.

license.name: metadata CC0; papers keep the author's chosen licence

access.rate_limit: one request every 3 seconds, and they enforce it
access.pagination: start= and max_results=, max 2000 per call, 30,000 total per query
access.etiquette: One request every 3 seconds, and they mean it. Back off for minutes after a 429 rather than retrying: a quick retry extends the block.

probes.note: arXiv's stated 3-second spacing, honoured by the prober. Observed 2026-09-07: a request that timed out at 30s, retried about a minute later, came back 429 - the penalty is a cooldown, not per-request spacing.

gotchas.trap: Atom XML only - there is no JSON mode, whatever a wrapper library implies.
gotchas.fix: Parse with feedparser or xml.etree; the namespace is http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom.

gotchas.trap: Faster than one call per 3 seconds gets you a 403 for a while.
gotchas.fix: Sleep 3s in the loop. For anything large, use the bulk S3 access instead.

gotchas.trap: Versions matter: the same paper has v1, v2, v3 with different dates and sometimes different conclusions.
gotchas.fix: The id carries the version suffix; decide up front whether you want v1 or latest.

gotchas.trap: A throttled call does not always answer 429. It can simply never answer - a 30-second read timeout with no status at all - and only the retry reveals the 429.
gotchas.fix: Treat a timeout against export.arxiv.org as rate limiting, not as an outage, and wait minutes before trying again.
